# GitHub template source and license

These files are adapted from [QuantumNous/new-api](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/tree/01da3a55f838cfa21010b05c7451c0a42cf5a173) at commit `01da3a55f838cfa21010b05c7451c0a42cf5a173`:

| TokenRouter file | Upstream file |
| --- | --- |
| `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/en.md` |
| `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml` | `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report_en.yml` |
| `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml` | `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request_en.yml` |
| `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` | `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` |
| `.agents/github/PR.md` | `.agents/github/PR.md` |
| `.agents/github/ISSUE.md` | `.agents/github/ISSUE.md` |

These template files retain the upstream GNU Affero General Public License, version 3. The upstream license text is preserved in [LICENSE.templates](LICENSE.templates).

Adapted for TokenRouter on 2026-10-28. Changes cover project names and links, provider and protocol support boundaries, upstream-error attribution, third-party service scope, PostgreSQL environment details, and source notices. Templates use English without emoji; duplicate language variants are removed. Agent routing, verbatim user requests, evidence requirements, and submission checks are retained. Filled answers use English without emoji, while verbatim user quotations retain their original language and form.
